columns.name: num_inspections
columns.description: The number of inspections the employee has conducted, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: is_under_Gregory_Cardenas
columns.description: Set to 1 if the employee is under the supervision of Gregory Cardenas, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: total_amount_of_fine
columns.description: The total amount of fine given by the employee, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: inspection_pass_rate
columns.description: The inspection pass rate of the employee. Pass rate is calculated as the number of inspections with results = 'Pass' divided by the total number of inspections.

columns.name: is_Sanitarian_and_has_inspected_the_facility_Burbank
columns.description: Set to 1 if the employee is a Sanitarian and has inspected the facility whose DBA name is 'Burbank', otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: dba_name
columns.description: The dba name of the facility.

columns.name: at_least_5_failed_inspection_bewteen_20100101_20151231
columns.description: Set to 1 if the facility has at least 5 failed inspections between 1/1/2010 and 12/31/2015, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: total_fine_2014
columns.description: The total fine the facility received in 2014, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_failed_inspections
columns.description: The percentage of failed inspections the facility has.

columns.name: has_paid_at_least_250_fine
columns.description: Set to 1 if the facility has paid at least $250 in fines for any single violation, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: num_violations
columns.description: The number of violations the facility has, replace NULL values with 0.
